'''''Pilgrimage''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] that depicted two [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warriors and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], with one of the two warriors pointing to the direction she should go.

==Behind the scenes==
''Pilgrimage'' was one of three paintings given out to players of the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' during the game's [[:w:c:swg:Life Day|Life Day event]] of 2005.
